reviews.text: I left my Olivia in this hotel for 10 days, I have to say it's wonderful, they're fabulous, they commented on it every day with videos, she was treated very well, I found it very good when I picked it up

Mr. Bellocci, thank you for your review.
Best regards from all the staff.

Thank you so much, Mr. Cassarino, for giving us your 5 stars!

Your appreciation is a source of great pride for us and an incentive to continue caring for our little guests every day with passion, professionalism, and so much love.

It will be a pleasure to welcome you back to Maison Sissy. See you soon!

Thank you for taking the time to write a review.

Best regards from all the staff at La Maison Sissy
We never left our French bulldog Nina; Nina stayed at Maison Sissy for 7 days and was treated like a princess! Thank you!

Initially, I had a great impression of the place: 24-hour security cameras, 4 walks, well-maintained facilities, and above all, extra attention to my dog, who, being a French bulldog, is much more delicate. It's expensive, but with all these extras, it was worth it, at least that's what I thought... the cameras aren't 24/7, but every few hours the viewing would stop. Initially, I didn't say anything, then I wrote to them about it, and they told me they'd had a problem and that everything would be back to normal. However, the same problem recurred in the following days. Today, I went to pick up my puppy and found him with a rash all over his face. I asked for an explanation, and they told me, "It must be the sanitizing products; it's caused irritation to other dogs too." Okay, if you've already had this problem, change the product, right? That said, I paid €180 for 3 nights only to find him like this.

I would not recommend this place.

A very disappointing experience. This is absolutely not a "luxury" dog hotel.

I left my dog ​​for three nights with the understanding that he would receive proper care, multiple daily walks, and attention. However, through the camera, he was almost always alone in the same small space, without toys or interaction, visibly bored and trying to escape.

Despite being told there are four walks a day, I only received one video, and when I asked for further updates, I was told that videos are only included in a private package—which was never clearly communicated in advance.

Overall, the service did not match what was promised at all. I would not recommend this place. A very disappointing experience. This is absolutely not a "luxury" dog hotel.

I left my dog ​​for three nights with the understanding that he would receive proper care, multiple daily walks, and attention. However, through the camera, he was almost always alone in the same small space, with no toys or interaction, visibly bored and trying to escape.

Despite being told there are 4 walks per day, I only received one video, and when I asked for more updates, I was told that videos are only included in a private package — which was never clearly communicated before hand.

Overall, the service did not match what was promised at all. I would not recommend this place.

Update after the owner's response:

Thank you for your response.

However, my review is based on what I personally observed through continuous camera access, not just a “limited moment.” The conditions I saw — including constant lighting at night, lack of stimulation, and long periods of isolation — do not reflect a comfortable or appropriate environment for a dog.

Duke came back visibly stressed and exhausted, which confirms my concerns.

I stand by my experience.

Thank you so much, Mr. Toniazzo, for your 5-star rating!
Your appreciation is a great source of satisfaction and a motivation to continue every day with passion, care, and attention to our little guests.

We look forward to seeing you soon at Maison Sissy!
Very negative experience.

Thank you so much, Mr. Michalany, for your 5-star rating!
Your appreciation is a great source of satisfaction and encourages us to continue with the same passion and attention to our little guests every day.

We always look forward to welcoming you back to Maison Sissy!

We were there with our dog Chanelle, we found a truly enchanting structure. The cameras gave us priceless serenity! The owner was helpful and very kind. Top staff, we need a structure like this in every region. Specialized for small and large sizes and thanks, see you next time

What more can I say? The atmosphere (with attention to detail), the reliable and qualified staff, and the owner, a person whose love and care for our furry friends comes first, speak for themselves. Without a doubt, the best place to entrust our four-legged friends. Thank you, Maison Sissy ❤️🐶 …

We left our chihuahua Willy at La Maison Siisy for boarding... A unique location! The staff is comparable to that of a 5-star hotel for humans... What struck us most was the living areas divided by shatterproof glass, not grates and/or doors like in other facilities. We also really appreciated the hygiene and safety standards. Willy, like all the other dogs, had access to a sofa/bed with an antibacterial cushion. Top!

We have an elderly dog ​​and weren't sure until the last minute whether to leave him at the shelter. Due to circumstances beyond our control, we were forced to. We handed him over directly to the owner, a man from another era, who took the matter to heart. When we returned, a few days later, we found our Beagle perfectly happy. We were impressed by both the location and the staff. The facility is second to none!!!

We left our furry hero at La Maison Sissy for a week, and he was treated like a prince!
We could see from the cameras how well he was doing. We also asked for videos of his walks, which were sent to us regularly. The staff were all excellent, uniformed and extremely kind. We highly recommend this facility for its high hygiene and safety standards. We also met Mr. Denny, a truly exceptional person!

I left my two dogs for a month-long stay while I was away. Despite the fact that they told me everything was fine, and sent me photos and weekly updates with 24/7 surveillance cameras, I found one of the dogs visibly malnourished and with ribs that I could feel. It was as if he hadn't eaten for a long time. When I picked them up, La Maison Sissy returned the leftover food I had brought them, which actually amounted to about two weeks' worth of supplies. Considering that they had always told me the dogs were fine and that everything was fine, I was disappointed and concerned to see one of the dogs showing visible signs of malnutrition. They could have alerted me to the fact that one of the dogs wasn't eating and we could have worked together to find an alternative solution. Unfortunately, this didn't happen. And I'm disappointed because I had placed my complete trust in them.

Thank you for your review.
Merry Christmas from the Maison Sissy staff
Maison Sussy Pet Hotel really surprised me. The staff is friendly and makes the animals feel like they're their own. The environment is clean and welcoming, and I had no problem leaving my pet Thor.

As someone who is greatly attached to their dog and provided dog boarding myself, I am very impressed with La Maison Sissy. I left my Pomeranian in their care and we were treated with so much kindness - Georgia and Marcello listened to my concerns and made sure that my dog has the best stay. He was placed in the room with other small dogs so he wasn’t scared or intimidated. It was nice  touch that medicine administration was included in the price of boarding.  24/7 access to video is great as you can see what your pet is up to during day and night. When I picked him up he was groomed and very happy. Grazie Mille, we will be back!
Thank you for the stars

Good afternoon
Yesterday my husband and our daughter visited Maison Sissy, and today our sweet Westy Bruschetta did a two-hour trial before leaving her with them for a week. I had done a Google search and was immediately intrigued by the place based on the pictures alone. Then our daughter confirmed that I had found a beautiful place, ideal for Bruschetta, who isn't used to being with anyone but us...my choice to always take care of her personally, even if it means making various sacrifices. A very well-kept, spotlessly clean place for small-to-medium sized dogs like her, and the staff are kind, attentive, and caring.
I'm so happy to have found you, and above all, I feel very at peace.
Thank you ❤️

It was such a joy to pick Bruschetta up yesterday, after 10 days with you, and to find her in excellent condition, happy, and at peace. A truly magnificent place, well-kept, spotlessly clean, with attentive, professional, and very kind staff.
THANK YOU SO MUCH ❤️

Bruschetta is now a regular at La Maison Sissy. Today
is her third stay with them, and we are so happy to know she's in such good hands with such sweet, affectionate, and knowledgeable people.
Thank you ❤️

We brought our Beagle here for a night. The facility is very beautiful, and when we entered the area where they keep the dogs, everyone was very calm and relaxed. There's music playing, and they take them on various outings; they even sent us videos.
Inhuman prices
Mrs. Francesca, thank you for the 5 stars 😊 …

Thank you so much
When travel calls and we can't take you with us,
it comforts us to know that, at Maison Sissy, your hearts beat peacefully.
Between gentle hands and caring gazes, you are cared for with sincere love,
and your every step is watched, day and night, by silent eyes.
We couldn't have found a better place. We can see our dogs 24/7 with shared cameras. Thank you for giving us peace of mind.
Great telephone contact. Pet-friendly hotel. Our dog was well-cared for, and we were left feeling at ease.
Thank you for taking the time to write a review. We look forward to hearing from you so we can give your little friend a 5-star experience. See you soon!
We thank you for your testimony 😌 …

Thank you so much for your five-star review! 💛⭐️
We're delighted that your experience with us was so positive: it's the greatest confirmation of our daily commitment to ensuring the well-being, serenity, and attention of every little guest.

We always look forward to welcoming you, ready to welcome you with the same smile and care as always! 🐾✨

We're sorry we didn't fully meet your expectations and would like to better understand what you weren't happy with.

Your opinions are precious to us: they help us improve and understand how to best care for our little four-legged guests. If you'd like, you can contact us by phone at +39 388 156 7867 or send us a private message: we'd be happy to listen and work together to find a solution.
All dog are welcome!

IF YOU LOVE YOUR DOG, ABSOLUTELY DO NOT BRING HIM HERE.
Try to find a dog sitter.
Our Sven has been through his first week... I just went to pick him up and found him so happy and beautiful! I highly recommend La Maison Sossy!!

What can I say? Simply wonderful. I left my Russian greyhound (borzoi) there, he didn't want to come home! They reassure you by sending you photos, the place is clean, quiet, the staff are very kind and professional. I would like to find the same cleanliness, friendliness, professionalism, and dedication in the hotels where I stay. Thank you so much, you are a guarantee.

Good morning, I've been taking my 4-year-old Bichon Frise Birillo to the daycare center for two years now. I learned about the facility through word of mouth, and after trying it, I've never left. I recently tried the hotel for three nights, with some apprehension because we never leave Birillo alone, as he suffers from being wandered off. We were able to see him with the camera provided by the facility, and when I asked how Birillo was, I immediately received a photo and reassurances. We'll be back as soon as possible. I must compliment the entire staff, who are all very attentive and passionate about caring for the dogs. The facility is immaculate, and the spaces and furnishings are worthy of a super-luxury hotel. The attention provided is always top-notch, and I must honestly say it doesn't get any better.
Long live Maison Sissy! With respect and appreciation, Paola Di Lieto and Birillo

It was our first time staying in a hotel for our poodle. We had a concert and didn't know where to leave Fiocco for the night, so we relied on them after reading the many positive reviews. We had a great time, and so did Fiocco. The place was clean and the staff were very friendly. The 24-hour service was excellent, allowing us to watch Fiocco via camera.

Ms. Camilla, we thank you warmly for your 5-star rating.
Best regards from all the staff.

Clean and well-kept environment, 24-hour security cameras, friendly and helpful. Very reliable.

I always leave my dog ​​with them (alone) when we're away and I can't bring her.

A special place, well-kept, clean, and managed with professionalism and care. We brought our French bulldog, who was born deaf and therefore fearful of everything, and she was cared for with the utmost care. Now leaving her there means entrusting her to trusted people. Thanks to all the staff... Well done 👏 …

I've taken Syd twice. It seems more like a place where you can leave your dog alone amidst constant barking. It's a damp place. I haven't seen any dog ​​training, playtime, or activities that stimulate the dog. In other words, a place with cameras, but not a place where the dog can play. Keeping him indoors isn't much different; in fact, he's comfortable indoors. I think you need to drastically change the management. You don't need places to leave your dog, but places where dogs can play and have fun.

Obviously, I haven't come back, even though I bought a 10-entry pass. I'd rather waste my money than leave my dog ​​there for even 10 minutes.
Very kind!
Very kind!
Wonderful place, the staff was knowledgeable and attentive to our needs. My dog ​​immediately felt at ease with the staff! We'll definitely be back! See you soon.

Nothing negative to say.
They're excellent and very professional.
My bully was very comfortable with his four-legged roommates.
I've been taking my bully to them for the holidays for two years now.
(Very well cared for.)
Excellent place!!! Highly recommended. Best time for our pets

NEVER AGAIN...
We left our dog for nine days, and when we picked him up, he was unrecognizable!!!
We immediately took him to the vet, and he told us he had bronchitis, a cough, and a cold. He had also lost 1 kg in nine days because he wasn't drinking. He was so weak he couldn't climb stairs.
We're so sorry!
Your feedback is important to us, and we're sorry to see your rating. Could you please contact us directly? We'd love to better understand your experience so we can improve our service. … More
Amazing dog sanctuary in Milan! I left my puppy there for a week, and she didn't want to come home. Beautiful environment, extremely comfortable, and friendly. I'll definitely be back.

Wonderful place!! I dropped my dog ​​off yesterday for temporary accommodation and immediately felt at ease! The place is super clean, with attention to every detail to make our dog feel comfortable! They have all the comforts and 24/7 assistance!! I absolutely recommend it!!

The best place for our beloved dogs I've ever seen! They have all the comforts and the loving care of the staff 24/7! The owner is super kind!!!
I recommend it to anyone who wants their dog to feel good!
